DECLARE @old int=(SELECT object_id FROM sys.internal_tables WHERE parent_id=OBJECT_ID(N't')); ALTER INDEX ix ON t REBUILD; SELECT CASE WHEN object_id=@old THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS same_id,REPLACE(name,CONVERT(nvarchar(20),parent_id),N'<parent>') AS name FROM sys.internal_tables WHERE parent_id=OBJECT_ID(N't'); SELECT i.name,i.index_id FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.internal_tables t ON i.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.parent_id=OBJECT_ID(N't') ORDER BY i.index_id;
